content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Autonomous Drone Simulator</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script type="module">
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Isometric god-like view
        camera.position.set(50, 50, 50);
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Custom environment: A creative floating island landscape with grass, trees, and rocks
        // Ground (floating island base)
        const groundGeometry = new THREE.CircleGeometry(40, 32);
        const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 }); // Green grass
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        ground.position.y = -1;
        scene.add(ground);

        // Add some hills/terrain variation
        const hillGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(10, 32, 32);
        const hillMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 });
        const hill1 = new THREE.Mesh(hillGeometry, hillMaterial);
        hill1.position.set(10, -5, 10);
        hill1.scale.set(1, 0.5, 1);
        scene.add(hill1);

        const hill2 = new THREE.Mesh(hillGeometry, hillMaterial);
        hill2.position.set(-15, -5, -10);
        hill2.scale.set(1.2, 0.6, 1.2);
        scene.add(hill2);

        // Trees (simple cone + cylinder)
        function createTree(position) {
            const trunkGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 5, 32);
            const trunkMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 });
            const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(trunkGeometry, trunkMaterial);
            trunk.position.copy(position);

            const leavesGeometry = new THREE.ConeGeometry(3, 6, 32);
            const leavesMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x006400 });
            const leaves = new THREE.Mesh(leavesGeometry, leavesMaterial);
            leaves.position.set(position.x, position.y + 5, position.z);

            scene.add(trunk);
            scene.add(leaves);
        }

        createTree(new THREE.Vector3(20, 0, 20));
        createTree(new THREE.Vector3(-20, 0, 20));
        createTree(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -25));
        createTree(new THREE.Vector3(15, 0, -15));

        // Rocks (spheres)
        const rockGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(3, 16, 16);
        const rockMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x808080 });
        const rock1 = new THREE.Mesh(rockGeometry, rockMaterial);
        rock1.position.set(25, 1, 0);
        scene.add(rock1);

        const rock2 = new THREE.Mesh(rockGeometry, rockMaterial);
        rock2.position.set(-10, 1, 25);
        rock2.scale.set(0.8, 0.8, 0.8);
        scene.add(rock2);

        // Drone model: Simple quadcopter (central body + 4 arms + propellers)
        const droneGroup = new THREE.Group();

        // Central body
        const bodyGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 2);
        const bodyMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFF0000 });
        const body = new THREE.Mesh(bodyGeometry, bodyMaterial);
        droneGroup.add(body);

        // Arms
        const armGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(3, 0.2, 0.2);
        const armMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x000000 });

        const arm1 = new THREE.Mesh(armGeometry, armMaterial);
        arm1.position.set(1.5, 0.5, 0);
        arm1.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;
        droneGroup.add(arm1);

        const arm2 = new THREE.Mesh(armGeometry, armMaterial);
        arm2.position.set(-1.5, 0.5, 0);
        arm2.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 4;
        droneGroup.add(arm2);

        const arm3 = new THREE.Mesh(armGeometry, armMaterial);
        arm3.position.set(0, 0.5, 1.5);
        arm3.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4 + Math.PI / 2;
        droneGroup.add(arm3);

        const arm4 = new THREE.Mesh(armGeometry, armMaterial);
        arm4.position.set(0, 0.5, -1.5);
        arm4.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 4 + Math.PI / 2;
        droneGroup.add(arm4);

        // Propellers (simple cylinders)
        const propGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 0.1, 32);
        const propMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xADD8E6 });

        const prop1 = new THREE.Mesh(propGeometry, propMaterial);
        prop1.position.set(2.5, 0.6, 1);
        prop1.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        droneGroup.add(prop1);

        const prop2 = new THREE.Mesh(propGeometry, propMaterial);
        prop2.position.set(-2.5, 0.6, -1);
        prop2.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        droneGroup.add(prop2);

        const prop3 = new THREE.Mesh(propGeometry, propMaterial);
        prop3.position.set(1, 0.6, 2.5);
        prop3.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        droneGroup.add(prop3);

        const prop4 = new THREE.Mesh(propGeometry, propMaterial);
        prop4.position.set(-1, 0.6, -2.5);
        prop4.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        droneGroup.add(prop4);

        droneGroup.position.set(0, 10, 0); // Start position
        scene.add(droneGroup);

        // Autonomous flight: Fly in a circular path around the island
        let time = 0;
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            // Update drone position autonomously
            time += 0.01;
            const radius = 30;
            droneGroup.position.x = Math.cos(time) * radius;
            droneGroup.position.z = Math.sin(time) * radius;
            droneGroup.position.y = 10 + Math.sin(time * 2) * 2; // Slight up-down motion

            // Rotate drone to face direction (simple yaw)
            droneGroup.rotation.y = -time;

            // Spin propellers for effect
            prop1.rotation.z += 0.1;
            prop2.rotation.z += 0.1;
            prop3.rotation.z += 0.1;
            prop4.rotation.z += 0.1;

            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Optional interactivity: Resize handling
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>Autonomous Drone Simulator</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; }
    canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
  <script>
    // Scene
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();

    // Camera
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(0, 50, 50);
    camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

    // Renderer
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Lights
    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
    scene.add(ambientLight);

    const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffffff);
    pointLight.position.set(0, 50, 50);
    scene.add(pointLight);

    // Custom Environment
    const planeGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100);
    const planeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x00ff00 });
    const plane = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeometry, planeMaterial);
    plane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    scene.add(plane);

    // Drone
    const droneGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 4);
    const droneMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
    const drone = new THREE.Mesh(droneGeometry, droneMaterial);
    drone.position.set(0, 5, 0);
    scene.add(drone);

    // Drone Movement
    let droneSpeed = 0.1;
    let droneDirection = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);

    function updateDronePosition() {
      drone.position.add(droneDirection.clone().multiplyScalar(droneSpeed));

      // Check for collisions with the plane
      if (drone.position.y < 1) {
        drone.position.y = 1;
        droneDirection.y = 0;
      }

      // Rotate the drone to match the direction
      drone.rotation.y = Math.atan2(droneDirection.x, droneDirection.z);
    }

    function updateDroneNavigation() {
      // Simple autonomous navigation algorithm
      if (Math.random() < 0.01) {
        droneDirection.x = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        droneDirection.z = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        droneDirection.normalize();
      }
    }

    // Animation Loop
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

      updateDronePosition();
      updateDroneNavigation();

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        camera.position.set(0, 50, 100);
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

            document.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown, false);
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove, false);
            document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp, false);

        // Create the environment (island with trees and lake)
        function createEnvironment() {
            // Island
            const islandGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(10, 10);
            const islandMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 });
            const island = new THREE.Mesh(islandGeometry, islandMaterial);
            island.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;

                const tree = new THREE.Mesh(treeGeometry, treeMaterial);
                tree.position.x = Math.random() * 8 - 4;
                tree.position.z = Math.random() * 8 - 4;
                scene.add(tree);
            }

            // Lake
            const lakeGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(3, 3);
            const lakeMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x0000FF, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5 });
            const lake = new THREE.Mesh(lakeGeometry, lakeMaterial);

            lake.position.y = 0.1;
            lake.position.x = 2;
            lake.position.z = 2;

            const droneGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 0.5, 1);

            drone.position.set(0, 2, 0);
            scene.add(drone);

            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            // Move the drone
            if (drone) {
                drone.position.x += 0.01;
                if (drone.position.x > 5) {
                    drone.position.x = -5;
                }
                drone.rotation.y += 0.01;

            renderer.render(scene, camera);

        function onMouseWheel(event) {
            camera.position.y += event.deltaY * 0.01;

        // Handle mouse down event
        let isDragging = false;
        let previousMousePosition = {
            x: 0,
            y: 0
        };

        function onMouseDown(event) {
            isDragging = true;
            previousMousePosition = {
                x: event.clientX,
                y: event.clientY
            };
        }

        // Handle mouse move event

            if (isDragging) {

                    x: event.clientX,
                    y: event.clientY
                };
            }
        }

        // Handle mouse up event

        }

prompt: Create an autonomous drone simulator (drone flies by itself, isometric god like view, optionally interactive. With a custom environment (optionally creative), using ThreeJS, output a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Autonomous Drone Simulator</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.132.2/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Initialize scene, camera, and renderer
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Add ambient and directional lights
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
        directionalLight.position.set(100, 100, 100);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Create ground
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100),
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x888888, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
        );
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        scene.add(ground);

        // Create obstacles (random cubes)
        for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            const cube = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 2, 2),
                new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x0000ff })
            );
            cube.position.set(x, 1, z);
            scene.add(cube);
        }

        // Create drone model
        const drone = new THREE.Group();
        
        // Body (red box)
        const body = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 2),
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 })
        );
        body.position.y = 0.5;
        
        // Propellers (green cylinders)
        const createPropeller = (x, z) => {
            const prop = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 16),
                new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00ff00 })
            );
            prop.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
            prop.position.set(x, 1, z);
            return prop;
        };
        
        drone.add(
            body,
            createPropeller(1, 0),
            createPropeller(-1, 0),
            createPropeller(0, 1),
            createPropeller(0, -1)
        );
        drone.position.set(0, 5, 0);
        scene.add(drone);

        // Define flight path waypoints
        const waypoints = [
            { x: 5, y: 5, z: 5 },
            { x: 5, y: 5, z: -5 },
            { x: -5, y: 5, z: -5 },
            { x: -5, y: 5, z: 5 }
        ];
        let currentWaypointIndex = 0;
        const speed = 0.1;

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            
            // Get current waypoint
            const waypoint = waypoints[currentWaypointIndex];
            const dx = waypoint.x - drone.position.x;
            const dz = waypoint.z - drone.position.z;
            const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
            
            // Switch to next waypoint when close enough
            if (distance < 0.5) {
                currentWaypointIndex = (currentWaypointIndex + 1) % waypoints.length;
            }
            
            // Move drone towards waypoint
            if (distance > 0.001) {
                drone.position.x += dx * speed / distance;
                drone.position.z += dz * speed / distance;
                drone.rotation.y = Math.atan2(dx, dz); // Rotate to face direction
            }
            
            // Update camera to follow drone (isometric view)
            camera.position.x = drone.position.x;
            camera.position.z = drone.position.z + 50;
            camera.position.y = 50;
            camera.lookAt(drone.position);
            
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        // Start animation
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Drone Simulator</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            background-color: #f0f0f0;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
        }
        #canvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100vh;
            display: block;
        }
    </style>

    <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
    <script>
        // Drone properties
        const DRONE_SPEED = 0.5;
        const DRONE_TURN_SPEED = 0.1;
        const DRONE_ALTITUDE = 10;

        // Environment properties
        const ENV_WIDTH = 100;
        const ENV_HEIGHT = 100;
        const ENV_DEPTH = 50;
        const OBSTACLE_COUNT = 10;

        // Drone class
        class Drone {
            constructor() {
                this.position = new THREE.Vector3(ENV_WIDTH / 2, ENV_HEIGHT / 2, DRONE_ALTITUDE);
                this.velocity = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0);
                this.rotation = new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0);
            }

            update() {
                // Autopilot logic
                if (this.position.x < ENV_WIDTH / 2) {
                    this.velocity.x = DRONE_SPEED;
                } else if (this.position.x > ENV_WIDTH - 10) {
                    this.velocity.x = -DRONE_SPEED;
                } else {
                    this.velocity.x = 0;
                }

                if (this.position.z < ENV_DEPTH / 2) {
                    this.velocity.z = DRONE_SPEED;
                } else if (this.position.z > ENV_DEPTH - 10) {
                    this.velocity.z = -DRONE_SPEED;
                } else {
                    this.velocity.z = 0;
                }

                this.position.add(this.velocity);

                // Rotate towards velocity direction
                this.rotation.y = Math.atan2(this.velocity.z, this.velocity.x);
            }
        }

        // Environment class
        class Environment {
            constructor() {
                this.obstacles = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < OBSTACLE_COUNT; i++) {
                    const obstacle = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.BoxGeometry(5, 5, 5),
                        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x888888 })
                    );
                    obstacle.position.x = Math.random() * ENV_WIDTH;
                    obstacle.position.z = Math.random() * ENV_DEPTH;
                    this.obstacles.push(obstacle);
                }
            }

            update() {
                // Nothing to update
            }
        }

        // ThreeJS setup
        const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-ENV_WIDTH / 2, ENV_WIDTH / 2, ENV_HEIGHT / 2, -ENV_HEIGHT / 2, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });

        // Create drone and environment
        const drone = new Drone();
        const environment = new Environment();

        // Add drone and obstacles to scene
        scene.add(drone.position);
        for (const obstacle of environment.obstacles) {
            scene.add(obstacle);
        }

        // Render loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            // Update drone and environment
            drone.update();
            environment.update();

            // Render scene
            camera.position.x = drone.position.x;
            camera.position.z = drone.position.z;
            camera.position.y = DRONE_ALTITUDE;
            camera.lookAt(drone.position);
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        animate();

        // Optional interactive mode
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
            switch (event.key) {
                case 'ArrowUp':
                    drone.velocity.z = DRONE_SPEED;
                    break;
                case 'ArrowDown':
                    drone.velocity.z = -DRONE_SPEED;
                    break;
                case 'ArrowLeft':
                    drone.velocity.x = -DRONE_SPEED;
                    break;
                case 'ArrowRight':
                    drone.velocity.x = DRONE_SPEED;
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (event) => {
            switch (event.key) {
                case 'ArrowUp':
                case 'ArrowDown':
                case 'ArrowLeft':
                case 'ArrowRight':
                    drone.velocity.set(0, 0, 0);
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        });
    </script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.155.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.155.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
<script>
    // Scene setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(40, 30, 40);
    camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: true});
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Controls
    const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
    controls.enableDamping = true;
    controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;
    controls.minPolarAngle = Math.PI / 4;
    controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI * 0.6;
    controls.enablePan = false;

    // Lighting
    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.8));
    const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
    directionalLight.position.set(50, 50, 50);
    scene.add(directionalLight);

    // Ground
    const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100, 10, 10);
    const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
        color: 0x555555,
        roughness: 0.8,
        metalness: 0.2
    });
    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = 0;
    scene.add(ground);

    // Buildings
    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
        const width = Math.random() * 5 + 2;
        const height = Math.random() * 25 + 5;
        const depth = Math.random() * 5 + 2;
        const building = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, height, depth),
            new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
                color: 0x888888 + Math.random() * 0x444444,
                metalness: 0.3,
                roughness: 0.7
            })
        );
        building.position.set(
            Math.random() * 80 - 40,
            height / 2,
            Math.random() * 80 - 40
        );
        scene.add(building);
    }

    // Skybox (simple gradient)
    const skyGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(500, 32, 32);
    const skyMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0x87CEEB,
        side: THREE.BackSide
    });
    const sky = new THREE.Mesh(skyGeometry, skyMaterial);
    scene.add(sky);

    // Drone
    const drone = new THREE.Group();
    const body = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 0.5, 2),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff2222, metalness: 0.7, roughness: 0.3 })
    );
    drone.add(body);

    // Propellers
    const propellerGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.2, 0.2, 1.2, 32);
    const propellerMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
        color: 0x22ff22,
        metalness: 0.6,
        roughness: 0.4
    });
    
    const propellers = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const propeller = new THREE.Mesh(propellerGeometry, propellerMaterial);
        propeller.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2; // horizontal
        propeller.position.set(
            (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * 1.5,
            0.75,
            (Math.floor(i / 2) % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * 1.5
        );
        drone.add(propeller);
        propellers.push(propeller);
    }
    scene.add(drone);
    drone.position.set(0, 5, 0);

    // Flight path
    const curvePoints = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
        const angle = i * Math.PI * 2 / 10;
        const radius = 30;
        curvePoints.push(new THREE.Vector3(
            Math.cos(angle) * radius, 
            5 + Math.sin(angle * 2) * 2,
            Math.sin(angle) * radius
        ));
    }
    const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(curvePoints, true);

    // Animation variables
    const clock = new THREE.Clock();
    let pathProgress = 0;
    const speed = 0.0015;

    // Animation loop
    function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        const delta = clock.getDelta();

        // Update drone position and rotation
        pathProgress += speed * delta * 100;
        if (pathProgress > 1) pathProgress = 0;
        const point = curve.getPoint(pathProgress);
        const tangent = curve.getTangentAt(pathProgress).normalize();
        const target = point.clone().add(tangent);
        drone.position.copy(point);
        drone.lookAt(target);

        // Rotate propellers
        propellers.forEach(propeller => {
            propeller.rotation.y += delta * 20;
        });

        controls.update();
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();

    // Handle window resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

</script>

    const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 });
    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    scene.add(ground);

    // Obstacles
    const obstacles = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const size = Math.random() * 1 + 0.5;
      const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
      const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 });
      const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      cube.position.set(
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15,
        size / 2,
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15
      );
      scene.add(cube);
      obstacles.push(cube);
    }

    // Drone
    const droneGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
    const droneMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
    const drone = new THREE.Mesh(droneGeometry, droneMaterial);
    drone.position.set(0, 0.25, 0);
    scene.add(drone);

    // Autonomous movement
    let target = new THREE.Vector3(
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15,
      0.25,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15
    );

    // Resize handling
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

    // Interaction
    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const mouse = new THREE.Vector2(
        (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1,
        -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1
      );

      const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
      raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);

      const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(ground);
      if (intersects.length > 0) {
        target.copy(intersects[0].point);
        target.y = 0.25; // Keep drone at ground level
      }
    });

    // Animation loop

      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

      // Move drone towards target
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3()
        .subVectors(target, drone.position)
        .normalize();
      drone.position.add(direction.multiplyScalar(0.05));

      // Check if drone reached target
      if (drone.position.distanceTo(target) < 0.1) {
        target.set(
          (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15,
          0.25,
          (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15
        );
      }

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();

content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Autonomous Drone Simulator</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.152.2/build/three.min.js"></script>
  <script>
    // Scene setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000));
    camera.position.set(30, 40, 50);
    camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Isometric controls (mouse orbit)
    let isDragging = false;
    let previousMousePosition = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const spherical = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(camera.position);

    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => isDragging = true);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => isDragging = false);
    window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      const deltaX = e.movementX || e.mozMovementX || e.webkitMovementX || 0;
      const deltaY = e.movementY || e.mozMovementY || e.webkitMovementY || 0;

      spherical.theta -= deltaX * 0.01;
      spherical.phi += deltaY * 0.01;
      spherical.phi = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(Math.PI - 0.1, spherical.phi));

      camera.position.setFromSpherical(spherical);
      camera.lookAt(scene.position);
    });

    // Resize handler
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

    // Lighting
    const hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x444444, 0.8);
    hemiLight.position.set(0, 100, 0);
    scene.add(hemiLight);

    const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
    dirLight.position.set(-30, 50, -30);
    scene.add(dirLight);

    // Ground
    const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(200, 200);
    const groundMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 });
    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    scene.add(ground);

    // Trees
    function createTree() {
      const group = new THREE.Group();

      const trunkGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.8, 4, 8);
      const trunkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 });
      const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(trunkGeo, trunkMat);
      trunk.position.y = 2;

      const leavesGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(2, 16, 16);
      const leavesMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 });
      const leaves = new THREE.Mesh(leavesGeo, leavesMat);
      leaves.position.y = 5;

      group.add(trunk);
      group.add(leaves);
      return group;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      const tree = createTree();
      tree.position.set(
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * 150,
        0,
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * 150
      );
      scene.add(tree);
    }

    // Rocks
    function createRock() {
      const geo = new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(Math.random() * 1 + 0.5, 0);
      const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x888888 });
      const rock = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
      return rock;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      const rock = createRock();
      rock.position.set(
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * 150,
        0,
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * 150
      );
      scene.add(rock);
    }

    // Drone
    const drone = new THREE.Group();

    const bodyGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 0.5, 1);
    const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x00ffff });
    const body = new THREE.Mesh(bodyGeo, bodyMat);
    drone.add(body);

    const propGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.5, 0.1, 0.1);
    const propMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });

    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const prop = new THREE.Mesh(propGeo, propMat);
      const angle = (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2;
      prop.position.x = Math.cos(angle) * 1.5;
      prop.position.z = Math.sin(angle) * 1.5;
      prop.rotation.y = angle;
      drone.add(prop);
    }

    scene.add(drone);

    // Autonomous movement logic
    let target = new THREE.Vector3(
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100,
      10,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100
    );

    function animateDrone() {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(target, drone.position).normalize();
      const distance = drone.position.distanceTo(target);

      if (distance < 2) {
        target.set(
          (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100,
          10 + Math.random() * 10,
          (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100
        );
      }

      drone.position.lerp(target, 0.02);
      drone.lookAt(target);
    }

    // Animation loop
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      animateDrone();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();
  </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Autonomous Drone Simulator</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://threejs.org/build/three.js"></script>
    <script src="https://threejs.org/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Orbit controls for interactive view
        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.25;

        // Camera positioning
        camera.position.set(30, 30, 30);
        camera.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0));

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
        directionalLight.position.set(1, 2, 3);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Landscape
        const planeGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100, 50, 50);
        const planeMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: 0x228b22, wireframe: false});
        const plane = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeometry, planeMaterial);
        plane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        scene.add(plane);

        // Elevation
        planeGeometry.vertices.forEach(vertex => {
            vertex.z = Math.random() * 10;
        });
        planeGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

        // Trees as obstacles
        const treeGeometry = new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 5, 32);
        const treeMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: 0x8B4513});
        for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            const tree = new THREE.Mesh(treeGeometry, treeMaterial);
            tree.position.set(Math.random() * 100 - 50, Math.random() * 5, Math.random() * 100 - 50);
            scene.add(tree);
        }

        // Drone
        const droneGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 2);
        const droneMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({color: 0x0000ff});
        const drone = new THREE.Mesh(droneGeometry, droneMaterial);
        scene.add(drone);

        // Drone path animation
        let dronePathIndex = 0;
        const dronePath = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 360; i += 5) {
            const radius = 20;
            const angle = i * Math.PI / 180;
            const x = radius * Math.cos(angle);
            const z = radius * Math.sin(angle);
            dronePath.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, 5, z));
        }

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            // Update drone position
            drone.position.copy(dronePath[dronePathIndex]);
            dronePathIndex = (dronePathIndex + 1) % dronePath.length;

            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
